remote='/root/afdo_probe-tv13-20261118'

env=f'export LC_ALL=C HOME={remote} TMPDIR={remote} PERF_BUILDID_DIR={remote}/buildid LD_LIBRARY_PATH={remote}; cd {remote} || exit 1; '

 for idx in 1 2; do
  printf 'TICKTIME '; cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime
  for pp in 233 1663; do
   exe=$(readlink /proc/$pp/exe)
   if test "$exe" = /usr/bin/enlightenment || test "$exe" = /usr/bin/source-service; then
    awk '{print "TICKS", $1, $2, $14+$15, $22}' /proc/$pp/stat
   fi
  done
  if test "$idx" = 1; then sleep 2; fi
 done
fi
'''
def fast_platform(out):
    clock=[float(x) for x in re.findall(r'^TICKTIME (\d+(?:\.\d+)?)',out,re.M)]
    ticks={}
    for pid,comm,n,start in re.findall(r'^TICKS (\d+) \(([^)]+)\) (\d+) (\d+)',out,re.M):
        ticks.setdefault((int(pid),comm,start),[]).append(int(n))
    if not clock:return None
    for key,values in ticks.items():
        for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(values,values[1:])):
            if i+1<len(clock) and clock[i+1]>clock[i] and (b-a)/(250*(clock[i+1]-clock[i]))>=0.25:
                return f'platform process elevated above baseline: {key}'
    return None
def utc(): return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
def run(label,args,timeout=30,shown=True,keep=True):
    start=utc()
    proc=subprocess.run(sdb+args,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,capture_output=True,timeout=timeout)
    if keep:
        for k in ('stdout','stderr'):
            (p/f'{label}.{k}').write_bytes(getattr(proc,k))
        (p/f'{label}.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(argv=sdb+args,start=start,end=utc(),rc=proc.returncode),indent=2)+'\n')
    if shown:
        print(label,proc.returncode,proc.stdout.decode(errors='replace')[:4500],proc.stderr.decode(errors='replace')[:1500],flush=True)
    return proc
def msg(label,cmd,timeout=30,shown=True,keep=True):
    script=f'{cmd}\nrc=$?; printf "\\n__TV_RC__=%s\\n" "$rc"; exit "$rc"'
    proc=run(label,['shell',script],timeout,shown,keep)
    match=re.search(rb'^__TV_RC__=(\d+)\s*$',proc.stdout,re.M)
    rc=int(match[1]) if match and not proc.returncode else None
    return rc,proc.stdout.decode(errors='replace')
def shell(label,cmd,timeout=30,shown=True):
    rc,out=msg(label,cmd,timeout,shown)
    if rc != 0:raise RuntimeError(f'{label}: board rc {rc}')
    return out
def occupied(out):
    s=re.findall(r'sdb-established (\d+)',out)
    if len(s)!=2 or sum(map(int,s))!=1:return 'unexpected SDB TCP connection count'
    for line in out.splitlines():
        w=line.split()
        if len(w)>=5 and w[0].isdigit() and re.search(r'^(?:perf(?:$|[-_])|gdb(?:server)?$|stress(?:[-_]|$)|sysbench$|fio$|afdo_|branch-[01]$)',w[-1],re.I):
            return f'potential concurrent test process: {line}'
        if len(w)>=6 and w[0].isdigit() and float(w[3])>=5 and (int(w[0]),w[-1]) not in platform and w[-1] not in ('sh','bash','ps','awk','head','cat','sed','grep'):

def check(label,wait=True):
    for n in range(4 if wait else 1):
        out=shell(f'gate-{label}-{n}',gate+platform_probe,shown=False)
        why=occupied(out) or fast_platform(out)
        print('gate',label,n,'pass' if why is None else why,flush=True)
        if not why:return
        if wait and n<3:time.sleep(600)
    raise RuntimeError(f'shared-board gate: {why}')
def inspect_watch(out):
    freq=[(float(a),int(b)) for a,b in re.findall(r'^FREQ (\d+(?:\.\d+)?) (\d+)\s*$',out,re.M)]

    bads=[]
    if not links or any(x!=1 for x in links):bads.append('unexpected SDB TCP count')
    if any(float(x)>31 for x in re.findall(r'^LOAD (\d+\.\d+)',out,re.M)):bads.append('load above gate')
    for pid,cpu,comm,owned in re.findall(r'^PROC (\d+) \d+ (\d+\.\d+) (\S+) (yes|no)',out,re.M):
        if owned=='no' and (re.search(r'^(?:perf(?:$|[-_])|gdb(?:server)?$|stress(?:[-_]|$)|fio$|sysbench$|afdo_|branch-[01]$)',comm,re.I) or ((int(pid),comm) not in platform and float(cpu)>=5 and comm not in ('sh','bash','ps','awk','head','cat','sed','grep','readlink','sleep','cut','tr','taskset'))):
            bads.append('foreign process '+comm)
    platform_change=fast_platform(out)
    if platform_change:bads.append(platform_change)
    return {'frequency_readings':freq,'contamination':sorted(set(bads))}

    rc,out=msg(label,env+'./watch.sh '+command,timeout,shown=False)
    s=inspect_watch(out)
    s['rc']=rc
    if not s['frequency_readings']:s['frequency_unavailable']=True
    state[label]=s
    print(label,'rc',rc,'freq',sorted(set(v for _,v in s['frequency_readings'])),'contamination',s['contamination'],flush=True)
    return rc,out
def summarize_ips(label,symbols):

    start,tail=text.rsplit('__TV_RC__=',1)
    counts=Counter()
    addr_frequency=Counter()
    unparsable=[]
    for line in start.splitlines():
        if not line.strip():continue
        m=re.fullmatch(r'\s*([UKHugKSOMDEB]+)\s+([0-9a-fA-F]+)\s*',line)
        if not m:
            unparsable.append(line[:160]);continue
        mode='kernel' if m[1]=='K' else 'user' if m[1]=='U' else 'other'
        counts[mode]+=1
        if mode=='kernel':addr_frequency[int(m[2],16)]+=1
    # Symbolize only with an address-bearing table from this same boot.
    irqs=Counter()
    asm=Counter()
    syms=Counter()
    used={}
    addresses=sorted(symbols)
    for ip,n in addr_frequency.items():
        offset=bisect_right(addresses,ip)-1
        if offset<0 or not addresses or ip>addresses[-1]:
            syms['[unknown]']+=n;continue
        addr=addresses[offset]
        name=symbols[addr]
        if ip-addr>1048576:
            syms['[unknown]']+=n;continue
        syms[name]+=n;used[name]=hex(addr)
        if re.search(r'(?:_raw_spin_unlock_irqrestore|arch_local_irq_enable|(?:arch_)?local_irq_restore)(?:$|[.])',name):
            irqs[name]+=n
        if re.search(r'^(?:vector_swi|__copy_.*|(?:__)?(?:memcpy|memmove|memset)(?:$|[.]))',name):
            asm[name]+=n

    (p/f'sample-{label}-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(val,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(label,'sample modes',val['counts'],'unknown rows',len(unparsable),flush=True)

    shell('root-verify','test "$(id -u)" = 0 && id -u')
    check('before-deploy')
    (p/'cleanup-journal.json').write_text(json.dumps({'path':remote,'phase':'registered-before-create','utc':utc()},indent=2)+'\n')
    shell('mkdir',f'umask 077; mkdir -- {remote}')
    owned=True
    manifest=json.loads((previous/'deployment.json').read_text())
    for name in ('watch.sh','record.sh'):
        f=p/name
        manifest[name]={'source':str(f.relative_to(root)),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'size':f.stat().st_size}
    (p/'deployment.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n')
    for name,item in manifest.items():
        f=root/item['source']
        assert hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==item['sha256'],name
        res=run('push-'+name,['push',str(f),remote+'/'+name],90,shown=False)
        if res.returncode:raise RuntimeError('push failed '+name)
    wanted=''.join(f"{item['sha256']}  {n}\n" for n,item in manifest.items())
    hash_cmd=env+'printf %s '+shlex.quote(wanted)+' | sha256sum -c -'
    shell('hashes',hash_cmd)
    try:
        shell('loader',env+'/lib/ld-linux.so.3 --list ./perf')
        shell('perf-version',env+'./perf --version')
        shell('perf-list-hw',env+'./perf list hw')
        shell('perf-list-raw',env+'./perf list raw')
        shell('perf-list',env+'./perf list',shown=False)
    except Exception:
        msg('loader-dmesg',"dmesg | tail -n 100 | grep -Ei 'smack|audit|denied|afdo_probe|perf|mmap|exec' | tail -n 30")
        raise
    shell('chmod-owned',env+'chmod 700 watch.sh record.sh')
    check('before-count')
    for trial in range(1,6):
        for version in (0,1):

            check(f"before-{key}")
            rc,_=watch(key,f'taskset -c 3 ./perf stat -x , -e cycles,instructions,r08,r0c,r10,r11,r12,r21 -- ./branch-{version}')
            if state[key]['contamination']:state[key]["discarded"]=True

    rc,_=watch('stat-privilege','taskset -c 3 ./perf stat -x , -e cycles:u,cycles:k,instructions:u,instructions:k,r0c:u,r0c:k -- ./branch-1')
    if state['stat-privilege']['contamination']:state['stat-privilege']['discarded']=True
    check('before-diagnostic')
    rc,_=watch('diagnostic-cpu3-cycles','./perf stat -x , -a -C 3 -e cycles -- sleep 1')
    if state['diagnostic-cpu3-cycles']['contamination']:state['diagnostic-cpu3-cycles']['discarded']=True
    check('before-idle')
    shell('idle-display','cat /sys/class/drm/card0-LVDS-1/status /sys/class/drm/card0-LVDS-1/enabled')
    rc,_=watch('record-idle','./record.sh idle',timeout=90)
    if state['record-idle']['contamination']:state['record-idle']['discarded']=True
    check('before-load')
    rc,bench=msg('bench-calibration',env+'taskset -c 3 ./perf bench sched pipe -l 100000',timeout=60)
    bench_time=re.search(r'Total time:\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*\[sec\]',bench)
    if rc==0 and bench_time and float(bench_time[1])>0:
        loops=int(100000*34/float(bench_time[1]))

            state['record-load']['fifo_calibration_loops']=loops
    else:state['record-load']={'skipped':'bench unavailable or no measured duration'}
    check('before-export',wait=False)
    sym_proc=run('kallsyms-transient',['shell','cat /proc/kallsyms'],timeout=40,shown=False,keep=False)
    symbols={}
    for addr,typ,name in re.findall(rb'^([0-9a-fA-F]+)\s+([tTwW])\s+(\S+)',sym_proc.stdout,re.M):
        value=int(addr,16)
        if value:symbols.setdefault(value,name.decode(errors='replace'))
    state['kallsyms']={'text_addresses_nonzero':len(symbols),'stderr':sym_proc.stderr.decode(errors='replace')[:500],'kept_full_table':False}
    del sym_proc
    for name in ('idle','load'):
        record=state.get('record-'+name,{})
        if record.get('rc')==0 and not record['contamination']:
            summarize_ips(name,symbols)

#!/bin/sh
export LC_ALL=C
probe_snapshot() {
    printf 'FREQ '; cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime | tr '\n' ' '
    cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy0/scaling_cur_freq
    printf 'TICKTIME '; cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime
    for pp in 233 1663; do
      exe=$(readlink /proc/$pp/exe)
      if test "$exe" = /usr/bin/enlightenment || test "$exe" = /usr/bin/source-service; then
        awk '{print "TICKS", $1, $2, $14+$15, $22}' /proc/$pp/stat
      fi
    done
    printf 'LOAD '; cat /proc/loadavg
    printf 'SDB '
    awk 'NR>1 && toupper($2) ~ /:65F5$/ && $4=="01" {n++} END {print n+0}' /proc/net/tcp /proc/net/tcp6
    ps -eo pid,ppid,pcpu,comm --sort=-pcpu | awk 'NR<=16 || tolower($4) ~ /perf|gdb|stress|test|bench|fio|afdo|branch-/' |
    while read -r pid ppid pcpu comm; do
        case "$pid" in *[!0-9]*|'') continue;; esac
        owned=no
        case "$comm" in
          perf|branch-*|watch.sh) if [ "$(readlink /proc/"$pid"/cwd)" = "$PWD" ]; then owned=yes; fi;;
        esac
        printf 'PROC %s %s %s %s %s\n' "$pid" "$ppid" "$pcpu" "$comm" "$owned"
    done
}
probe_snapshot
"$@" &
job=$!
while kill -0 "$job" 2>/dev/null; do
    probe_snapshot
    sleep 1
done
wait "$job"
rc=$?
probe_snapshot
exit "$rc"
